title: The Portal
after: You spin around and get a really good view out the windows. “Are those stars…where the heck did I end up…is this a spaceship?” you say as you look out at the vastness of space and stars.
alt: The fully covered explorer lands in a metal corridor and looks out at the stars through a wide window.

title: The Bridge
after: All of them are dressed the same, in loose-fitting grey jumpsuits with zippers down the middle and patches everywhere.
alt: Captain Aster, Percy at the flight controls, and Trace gather on the ship’s bridge in patched gray jumpsuits.

title: Permission to Come Aboard
after: You put it on right there, over your clothes. Did I mention it’s about three sizes too big? It’s about three sizes too big. You have to roll the sleeves up four times.
alt: The explorer tries on an oversized crew jumpsuit while Captain Aster, Percy, and Trace look on.
revisionNote: Broad-brim expedition hat matched to The Portal, per user feedback.

title: The Engine Room
after: You sit down on the floor beside him with your notebook, and for a while the two of you just watch the light. You draw it. Bright, dim. Bright, dim.
alt: The explorer sketches the blue power core beside Trace while a small solar-panel maintenance robot carries an oil can.

title: Everyone Aboard
after: Afterward, the cargo bay is full of blankets and hot drinks and tired voices. A tall robot rolls through on a pair of treads with a stack of blankets balanced on its forklift claws. It’s got a solar panel on its head, one big camera eye, and a round speaker in its chest, and every time it hands somebody a blanket, the speaker announces, “CARGO SECURED.” Nobody corrects it.
alt: The tracked cargo bot hands a blanket to a young gray-eared passenger among rescued alien families.

title: Off the Ice
after: She opens the case. It’s full of glowing data crystals.
alt: Dr Wren, wrapped in three blankets, opens a silver case of glowing data crystals while Captain Aster listens.

title: Keeper Cobble
after: They’re very large, and very old, and very wrinkly, with a great domed shell on their back and a blanket over their knees. They’ve got a crystal in one hand, and they’re singing along with it…to an open drawer of seeds.
alt: Keeper Cobble sings with a glowing crystal in hand beside an open seed drawer in their lamplit room.

title: I Love Tight
after: Rock fills the window on both sides. You could read the writing on it, if rocks had writing. Something scrapes along the bottom of the ship with a long, slow SCREEEECH that you feel in your teeth.
alt: The Rescue Corps ship squeezes between jagged space rocks, scraping sparks from its hull.

title: Belts
alt: The explorer, Captain Thyme, Ratchet and Trace run through a tilting corridor while holding up their trousers.

title: One More
after: A metal hand closes around the back of your jumpsuit.
alt: Trace grips the back of the explorer’s jumpsuit as a hull breach pulls an archive crate into space.

title: The Convoy
after: It fills half the window. There’s no screen in the way, and no dot for scale. It’s an ocean of darkness, with the stars just stopping at its edge, and it’s moving away from you slowly, like a whale that hasn’t noticed the minnows. Twelve small ships hang helpless in the dark behind it.
alt: Twelve stranded convoy ships hang against the World-Eater’s immense starless silhouette as the rescue ship approaches.

title: Catch
after: The shuttle goes in through the doors, bounces twice, and skids the whole length of the bay in a shower of sparks. The cargo bot rolls out of the way just in time. Behind you, the tow cable pulls tight, and the twelfth ship gets dragged along in the {world_name}’s shadow. The big ship’s engines cough, and catch, and ROAR, and she swings up and out of the cold with every light on board flickering.
alt: The shuttle skids across the bay on its landing skids, throwing sparks as the cargo bot moves aside.

title: Hold On to Something
after: “I have NOODLES in my EYES!” Percy shouts. “I have a LOT of eyes!”
alt: Percy floats above the pilot’s chair with noodles tangled around their eye stalks while Captain Aster holds a ceiling rail.

title: Stung
after: You don’t hear it, because there’s no sound in space. But you feel it, in your ribs, in the deck, in the air…a huge, low note from something that has never once been hurt, finding out what it’s like. A crack of white light runs across the darkness from one side to the other, like lightning across a night sky.
alt: A thin white beam from the rescue ship strikes the World-Eater’s red opening as a crack of light crosses its surface.

title: The Wall of Names
after: Captain Aster comes to stand beside you.
alt: The explorer and Captain Aster stand beside Harbor’s flower-lined memorial wall as an artisan carves beneath SOLARIS.
